description: This file is a Go source file implementing code generation logic for Kubernetes API group/version registration, including target creation and internal package checks.

methods.name: NameSystems
methods.description: Returns the name system used by the generators in this package.

methods.name: DefaultNameSystem
methods.description: Returns the default name system for ordering the types to be processed by the generators.

methods.name: GetTargets
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of code generation targets based on package context and arguments.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Determines whether a package contains internal types based on the presence of 'TypeMeta' and 'json' tags.
